head: Gemini Live on Google Home speakers gets faster, for Premium users
dek: Google says Gemini Live on its speakers and smart displays will soon move to its newer speech-to-speech system, which it says answers much faster. You'll also be able to set timers and control smart home devices without leaving the conversation.
details: Until now, Live was mainly for longer chats and couldn't take commands mid-session. You can also interrupt it to change the topic. Live still isn't what "Hey Google" starts by default: you open it with a phrase like "let's chat". Google gave no date beyond "soon" and no list of countries.
where: Google Home speakers and smart displays, "soon"; needs Google Home Premium (10 dollars a month) or Google AI Pro
means: If you pay for Google Home Premium or Google AI Pro, talking to your speaker should feel quicker, and you can switch the lights or set a timer mid-chat. Without a subscription nothing changes: Gemini Live on these devices has always needed one.
todo: Nothing to do yet; once it arrives, say "let's chat" to your speaker to try it.
thumb_words: GEMINI LIVE GETS FASTER ON NEST
